schema: D590 prop venue terms: one record per Plan in scripts/d386_full_lifecycle.py PLANS, every field carrying its own provenance.
model_assumptions_not_attached_to_any_fi: D386 ASSUMPTIONS #4: daily P&L is Gaussian in scripts/d386_full_lifecycle.simulate. Real P&L is fat-tailed, which RAISES the chance of clearing a high daily-profit threshold at small size and LOWERS survival. Both effects are unmodelled; hurdle_p.p4_life's measured provider is the route that does not assume it (D440).
D386 ASSUMPTIONS #5: the 7-day (MFFU) and 30-day (Apex) inactivity rules are NOT modelled; at every risk level D386 tested they are cleared comfortably.
